name: agentpay-tools-mcp-server
title: AgentPay Doc Tools
summary: PDF to per-page text, RSS/Atom/JSON Feed to normalized JSON, and sitemaps to URL lists for AI agents. Listing tools is free; tool calls are paid per call.
description: AgentPay Doc Tools is a remote MCP server (Streamable HTTP, stateless) with three tools: tools_pdf_text (per-page text from a PDF URL up to 20 MB, $0.01), tools_feed (RSS, Atom or JSON Feed parsed into normalized JSON items, $0.005) and tools_sitemap (a site's URLs from its sitemaps, following robots.txt and sitemap indexes, $0.005). Each tool fetches the URL you provide at request time. Connecting, initialize and tools/list are free and need no account or API key. Tool calls are priced in USDC and paid either per call with x402 (USDC on Base, eip155:8453, or on Algorand) passed in the tool call's _meta field, or by sending an optional Authorization: Bearer header with a prepaid credits key bought at https://agentpay.agentpay-apis.workers.dev/credits/buy. Tool calls send the requested URL and any supplied options to AgentPay.

useCases.name: PDF text extraction
useCases.description: Extract per-page text from a PDF at a public URL (up to 20 MB) for summarization or question answering.

useCases.name: Feed monitoring
useCases.description: Parse RSS, Atom or JSON Feed URLs into normalized JSON items to track news, blogs or release notes.

useCases.name: Site discovery
useCases.description: List a site's URLs from its sitemaps, following robots.txt and sitemap indexes, to plan crawls or content audits.
